gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.747463 45.427886)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.747463 45.427886)',4326)::geography,
        4000
      )
  AND amenity = 'university';
